// Select research content type and topic
const contentTypes = [
  "paper-summary",
  "discovery",
  "methodology",
  "data-source",
  "tool",
  "case-study",
  "trend",
  "formula",
  "documentation"
];

const categories = [
  "nasa",
  "orbital-mechanics",
  "astrophysics",
  "quantum-physics",
  "aerospace",
  "general"
];

const topics = [
  "orbital debris mitigation",
  "precision orbit determination",
  "space weather effects",
  "satellite constellation design",
  "propulsion systems",
  "attitude control",
  "mission design",
  "data analysis techniques",
  "numerical methods",
  "recent NASA discoveries",
  "exoplanet research",
  "black hole physics",
  "quantum computing in space",
  "materials science for space"
];

const selectedType = contentTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * contentTypes.length)];
const selectedCategory = categories[Math.floor(Math.random() * categories.length)];
const selectedTopic = topics[Math.floor(Math.random() * topics.length)];
const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
const id = `research-${Date.now()}`;

return {
  json: {
    id,
    date: today,
    type: selectedType,
    category: selectedCategory,
    topic: selectedTopic,
    prompt: `Generate comprehensive research content for PhD students and researchers about ${selectedTopic} in the ${selectedCategory} category.

Content type: ${selectedType}

Requirements:
1. Provide a detailed summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Write full content suitable for research papers (500-1000 words)
3. Include relevant keywords
4. Provide references to academic papers, NASA documentation, or authoritative sources
5. Include formulas/equations if applicable
6. Include data points if applicable
7. Suggest related topics
8. Include SEO keywords

Format as JSON:
{
  "title": "...",
  "summary": "...",
  "content": "...",
  "keywords": ["..."],
  "references": [{"title": "...", "url": "...", "source": "...", "type": "paper|website|documentation|data|tool"}],
  "formulas": [{"name": "...", "equation": "...", "description": "..."}],
  "dataPoints": [{"label": "...", "value": "...", "unit": "...", "source": "..."}],
  "relatedTopics": ["..."],
  "seoKeywords": "..."
}`
  }
};
